items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: he had a pretty good band. He had Frankie Doosen on trombone.

ctx.x: I didn't know that we see Punch all the time.
I don't remember that. Yeah, ask him. Just ask him about Galloway. Yeah, we'll ask him. Uh-huh. And, uh, he had, he had a pretty good band. He had Frankie Doosen on trombone.
